Published sources jar: https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/openrewrite/rewrite-java-21/8.17.1/rewrite-java-21-8.17.1-sources.jar (SHA-1 f133bd0ba96af8944d46df8997decc80fe01ef13)
